layer1.name: Secret
layer1.one_liner: Anonymous posting to your phone contacts and their networks.
layer1.description: Posts appeared to your contacts without attribution, spreading outward through their networks. Free, consumer, venture-backed, with virality strong enough at t0 that retention had not yet been tested.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down roughly 16 months after launch. Rapid early growth did not convert into repeat use, and the anonymity that drove adoption also drove the behaviour that drove people away.
